Designers at Milan Fashion Week Break Free from House Codes

At Milan Fashion Week, designers from Fendi, Marni, and Jil Sander are reportedly breaking away from traditional house codes. Maria Grazia Chiuri's designs for Fendi featured upbeat, body-conscious runway looks, while Simone Bellotti's collection for Jil Sander showcased creased textures. The collections for Spring/Summer 2027 are noted for sheer glamour and distorted tailoring.
